metadata.title: EP-1.1 Juniors Write Code, Seniors Build Systems: Full Project Setup from LLD to Production with AI
metadata.description:
Juniors write code. Seniors build systems.

Episode 1.1 - Pick Up Your Weapons, Parth 🏹

Share your feedbacks, requests & suggestions with us - https://forms.gle/KnDMvco3oJ1fZBut5

In this episode, we take a real project from 0 to production, the way senior engineers actually do it.

**What we cover in this episode:**

1. Prerequisites
2. Overview of Our Weapons (Astra)
3. Engineer vs Architect - Difference with Examples
4. Setting up the Environment - App Pick, HLD vs LLD, Tech Stack
5. Making Friends with AI - Claude Setup (Rules, Hooks & Training)
6. NodeJS Problems & PM2 - Why? What? How?
7. Nexus Console & Docker - Why? What? How?
8. K6 for Load Testing - Why? What? How?
9. Grafana & Prometheus for Monitoring - Why? What? How?
10. Nginx as Reverse Proxy - Why? What? How?
11. Data Seeding - Why? What? How?

By the end, you will know how to setup, deploy and monitor a project like it is running in production.

If you are preparing for system design interviews or building a scalable backend or planning to master system design engineering, do not miss this.
